title: Soul Snack #4: Intuition is the Voice of the Non-Physical World
excerpt: ﻿ In today’s Soul Snack, Gary Zukav explores the power of intuition and its vital role in our spiritual growth.
bodyHtml:
In today’s Soul Snack, Gary Zukav explores the power of intuition and its vital role in our spiritual growth. 

He explains how intuition is the voice of the non-physical world and why, as multisensory beings, we are able to access wisdom far beyond the limitations of our five senses.

Gary guides us on how to cultivate and trust our intuition, using it not only for practical reasons like safety and decision-making but also as a powerful tool for creativity, personal transformation, and deeper spiritual understanding.

Gary also shares that developing intuition requires an open, curious approach to life, emotional and nutritional cleanliness, and a willingness to experiment with what you receive. 

By asking the right questions and trusting that the answers will come, we align ourselves with the boundless wisdom of the Universe.

This soul snack encourages listeners to explore how they experience intuition and provides practical steps to deepen their connection to it.

What You’ll Discover in This Episode:

  • (00:41): What intuition truly is and why it’s vital for multisensory beings like us.
  • (01:51): How intuition supports both everyday decisions and deeper spiritual growth.
  • (06:23): Why maintaining cleanliness in your emotions and diet enhances your intuitive abilities.
  • (09:26): Why your intuition will guide your self-awareness but never directly tell you what to do.
